name: ltp-v2-monorepo
description: Sistema Integral de Gestión Escolar LTP v2.0 (Frontend React + Backend Express Serverless + Supabase PostgreSQL)

scripts.install-all: npm install --include=dev --prefix backend && npm install --include=dev --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm install --include=dev --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix backend && npm install --include=dev --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
